lead_fa: Frost بازی پروک-محور با کنترل میدان است: با [[Flurry]] و [[Ice Lance]] و Glacial Spike آسیب می‌زنی و با Frost Nova و Blizzard دشمنان را کند و ریشه‌کن می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Spellslinger]] با جریان Frost Splinter و [[Frostfire]] با Frostfire Bolt و Glacial Spike قوی‌تر؛ در حال حاضر متعادل‌اند.

strengths: Flexible damage profile with Ray of Frost as a major cooldown
Effective against two stacked targets with Splitting Ice
Strong mobility: Blink/Shimmer, Alter Time, Incantation of Swiftness, instant cast procs
Battlefield control: Frost Nova, Freeze, Blizzard, Frostbolt slows and roots
weaknesses: Ray of Frost leaves you vulnerable to movement and interrupts
No spread cleave when targets are separated
Very limited self-healing makes sustained unavoidable damage dangerous

changes_12_1.note: 12.1 brings smaller tuning changes; the biggest adjustment is the new tier set, which provides a significant bonus to Glacial Spike.

hero.recommendation: Spellslinger and Frostfire look balanced right now, with both options having strengths in different situations.
hero.spellslinger: Focuses on Ice Lance powering a continuous stream of Frost Splinters; Reactive Barrier for defense.
hero.frostfire: Adds Fire magic with Frostfire Bolt, Duality, Isothermic Core, Imbued Warding; relies more on Frostfire Bolt and Glacial Spike and must talent into Comet Storm; Imbued Warding generally wins the defensive comparison.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Frost Mage Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/mage/frost/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Brain Freeze Flurry must be spent without delay; Ice Lance consumes Fingers of Frost.
Ray of Frost is the major cooldown: get the full channel off (Shimmer to safety instead of canceling).
Freezing stacks (from the set and spells) power Ice Lance.

st_spellslinger: Flurry if Brain Freeze is active and Thermal Void is not active
Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is at 2 stacks
Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active
Ice Lance if Freezing at 6 or more stacks
Ray of Frost if at 3 or fewer Icicles
aoe: Same as single target plus Blizzard at 3+ targets and making sure Frozen Orb hits as many targets as possible
Blizzard if Freezing Rain is active
Blizzard as a filler before Frostbolt
rotation.ray_of_frost_notes: Ray of Frost deals a lot of damage and generates many Freezing stacks; the key is getting the full channel off: plan ahead and Shimmer to safety instead of canceling.

gear.gearing_rules: You mainly need 4 tier pieces, strong trinkets, and ideally the special cantrip items from the raid; the rest is mostly item level. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Primal Leywarden's Attire
tier_set.pc2: Each stack of Freezing/Shattered has a 4% chance to generate an Icicle; Glacial Spike damage increased by 20%.
tier_set.pc4: Casting Glacial Spike has a chance to rapidly generate 5 Icicles over 1 sec; Shatter damage increased by 5%.
tier_set.note: Greatly improves Glacial Spike value; adds small rotational changes to Spellslinger and makes Frostfire viable.

notes: Mastery is the safest secondary; sim for exact splits.

mplus.hero_note: Spellslinger carries the Best tags in M+ and Delves; Frostfire wins stacked cleave raids.
tips: Blizzard with Freezing Rain between Frozen Orbs is your pack rotation backbone.
Frost Nova + Freeze hold packs for the tank; Frostbolt slow keeps runners in range.
Ice Block and alter-time tricks let you survive the unavoidable dungeon bursts.
